visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Animation/graphic-based elements appear on a large screen in an office setting. A woman with long hair wearing a beige vest over a white shirt stands next to the screen, gesturing toward it. A man with glasses and a dark baseball cap sits at a wooden table, looking at her. (2) Close-up on the man's face as he looks downward at a piece of paper, his expression skeptical. The background shows a white wall with handwritten text. (3) A close-up shot focuses on a clear glass bowl filled with cereal and yellow-tinted milk on a light wood table. (4) The man is shown eating the cereal with a spoon; he is now wearing a yellow headband and a pearl necklace. The woman stands beside him, holding a large red bag of Kellogg's cereal with honey and almond imagery. (5) In a series of jump cuts, the man appears in different stages of cross-dressing while eating the cereal, eventually wearing a long-haired wig and a feminine blouse. He smiles and gestures with a strawberry. (6) A static shot displays three bags of Kellogg's Granola (Honey Almond, Strawberry, and Cacao Hazelnut flavors) standing on a table next to a glass of milk. (7) The man, fully dressed in a feminine outfit with a wig and headband, holds the three bags of cereal and smiles at the camera in a brightly lit room. (8) The scene returns to the office; the woman gives two thumbs up toward a laptop screen while the man looks directly at the camera with a confused expression.
